purpose: Define exactly when EARTH and SPACE rows are allowed to be compared, joined or interpreted as a shared residual. This prevents aggregate, policy and detector-pipeline rows from being silently treated as physical events.

representation_contract.target_invariant: prospectively defined shared temporal/spatial residual surviving independent Earth and Space controls
representation_contract.earth_representation: source-bound terrestrial event ledger with reporting-pipeline state
representation_contract.space_representation: observation-opportunity-aware Palomar/transient ledger with detector state
representation_contract.metric_rights: A temporal coincidence metric is admissible only when both rows have compatible temporal precision and each domain has independently valid observation/reporting opportunity.

conditions: event is not merely an archive/policy aggregate

EARTH.AGGREGATE.reason: Fiscal-year/reporting-period counts cannot be matched to individual Space observation days without event-level rows.

EARTH.POLICY_CHANGE.reason: Policy rows are covariates for reporting opportunity, not sky events.

EARTH.ARCHIVE_SERIES.reason: Archive coverage is provenance, not event identity.

conditions: date materialized from source-bound plate/tile metadata
candidate count and opportunity columns present

SPACE.COHORT_OR_MODEL_RESULT.reason: Cohort/model summaries are evidence about populations, not individual day witnesses.

join_levels.description: Compare which sources, detector chains and reporting rules exist. No physical coincidence inference.
Compare broad historical/reporting intervals for design purposes only. No event-level enrichment claim.

join_levels.current_blocker: SPACE ledger has no materialized 312-row observation-day table yet.
join_levels.unlock: Materialize and freeze the 312 unique Palomar observation days with observation opportunity and detector-state columns.

join_levels.current_blocker: Requires independent survival of Earth and Space null models plus a prospectively frozen shared feature.

earth_nulls: non-nuclear facility or site-class controls where available
null_and_control_contract.cross_domain_null: Preserve Earth event timing and Space observation schedule separately; randomization/permutation must not destroy each domain's internal opportunity structure.

current_execution_state.reason: The contract refuses to invent a 312-day Palomar table from aggregate summaries.

next_execution.goal: Create the source-bound 312-row Palomar observation-day table, then freeze it before joining any Earth event dates.
next_execution.success: Every historical day in the study interval can be classified as NO_OBSERVATION, OBSERVED_ZERO or OBSERVED_WITH_CANDIDATES using explicit public metadata.
next_execution.failure_or_blocked: If day-level metadata cannot be source-bound, preserve the block and do not perform a coincidence test.

canonical_seal: DO NOT JOIN STORIES. JOIN SOURCE-BOUND ROWS WITH COMPATIBLE TIME, DENOMINATORS AND DETECTOR CONTRACTS.
